content.short: Canvas Connect is a privacy Layer-2 blockchain offering confidential, scalable and low-cost transactions via ZK rollups.
content.description: Canvas Connect delivers regulated privacy to the digital economy through an API-first, privacy-focused Layer-2 network. It enables faster, cheaper confidential transmission of value and payment information on Ethereum without needing Solidity or other blockchain programming languages. Aimed at financial institutions, government bodies, and corporates, the platform helps them implement blockchain-based finance in a tokenized world and overcome the barriers of traditional blockchain infrastructure.
